description: Source code for managing an X11 window with optional EGL/OpenGL context creation, including window creation, event handling, and key symbol translation for a Raspberry Pi 4 environment.

methods.name: fatalError
methods.description: Prints an error message and exits the program.

methods.name: WaitForMapNotify
methods.description: Waits for the MapNotify event for window mapping.

methods.name: describe_fbconfig
methods.description: Outputs details of a GLX framebuffer configuration.

methods.name: createTheWindow
methods.description: Creates and initializes an X11 window with optional EGL/OpenGL context, handling fullscreen, borders, and window properties.

methods.name: createTheRenderContext
methods.description: Creates an OpenGL rendering context using GLX.

methods.name: updateTheMessageQueue
methods.description: Processes X11 events and invokes callback functions.

methods.name: x11_set_event_callback
methods.description: Sets the callback function for X11 events.

methods.name: x11_create_window
methods.description: Public API to create an X11 window with specified parameters.

methods.name: x11_gl_swap
methods.description: Swaps the front and back buffers for rendering.

methods.name: x11_keycode_to_keysym
methods.description: Converts a keycode to a keysym, considering shift state.
